name: Estimated Kerberos authentications
description: Workbook estimate: sum of per-second samples multiplied by 60; assumes one sample per minute.
kql:
Perf
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where ObjectName == "Security System-Wide Statistics" and CounterName == "Kerberos Authentications"
| summarize Value = sum(CounterValue) * 60, Timestamp = max(TimeGenerated) by Series = Computer
